author: Unreal Engine
description:
For KPop Demon Hunters’ concert scene, Sony Pictures Imageworks were able to animate hundreds of lights and easily export them with a custom plugin via USD into Katana. The team were able to preserve the animation form UE for the lights in Katana, removing the need for thousands of extra frames and a surplus of data.

Dive into how the team used UE in our spotlight here: https://epic.gm/spotlight-kpop-demon-hunters

And stream Kpop Demon Hunters now on Netflix!
title: Hundreds of lights were animated for KPop Demon Hunters’ concert scene
